span.div:
Invalidation flow:
1. Client writes user:123 → Cache 1 (leader)
2. Leader updates local cache
3. Leader broadcasts invalidation to Cache 2 and Cache 3
4. Followers invalidate (or update) their copies
5. Leader acknowledges client
6. Read-after-write consistency guaranteed via leader

span.p:
Cache Client Library
- Discovers leader via consensus
- Sends writes to leader
- Reads from any node (eventual)
